image_description: A close-up, high-contrast photograph of a bright green snake coiled on a dark surface. The snake has vibrant lime-green scales with a glossy texture. The head is visible in profile, featuring a large dark eye and distinct scale patterns. The body loops around, showing the lateral compression typical of arboreal snakes.
